curtains.plan: WMC7: one front stack X -2.29..-2.15, Y 2.65-2.95, track Z 2.86, to the floor; never over glazing
curtains.verdict: PARTIAL (colour), geometry pass. Colour: the layer reads a warm flax / oatmeal (median chroma ~15, hue ~75 deg) where the card's photo is a pale cream (chroma ~7, hue ~93 deg) and the room's white plaster stays near neutral (chroma 2-5), so the room's light does not explain it; not recoloured in code (no separate grade; for QA / the designer). Geometry: the stack keeps the WMC7 width (step 2 drew it twice as wide, over the whole first pane). Its inner edge follows the clay from the track down and the hem flares out to ~2.6 cm beyond it, so the soft edge lies over the first pane's 46 px glass strip by a median ~10 px (max 17) in the lower rows. Semi-sheer beige linen with slub, matte; it reads a little warmer and darker than the card's cream in the room's shaded front corner
